page.layout: One printed page, one text column with a running head at the top. Marginal notes stand in the right margin beside the lines they belong to. Below the text: catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: uio quindecim mutua numerata mihi de domo: & hæc quindecim proba recte dari kalendis futuris stipulatus est Mævius Publius. Spopondi ego Lucius Titius: si die suprascripta summa Publio Mævio, eiue ad quem ea res pertinebit, data, soluta, satisve eo nomine factum non erit, tunc eo amplius {*}quo post quoad. soluã, poenæ nomine in dies triginta, inque denarios centenos, denarios singulos dari stipulatus est Pub. Mævius. Spopondi ego Lucius Titius: convenit q; inter nos, uti {*}pro Pub. Mævio ex summa suprascripta menstruos refundere de-

page.notes: Mę in "Publio Mę uio" is printed as Mæ with a doubtful ligature; read as Mæuio (Mævio). The "ei'ue" with an apostrophe-like mark is read as eiue. "fa&um" is printed with the ct ligature and read as factum. "soluã" carries a tilde over the a as printed. Running head is damaged at its left end; only LECTA. is legible. Catchword "beam" completes the hyphenated word "de-beam" on the next page.
